_comment: ElevenLabs dashboard -> Solomate agent -> Tools -> Add Tool -> Server Tool. The two body properties below are bound to ElevenLabs' built-in system variables, so the LLM does NOT fill them in — the platform injects the real conversation id and full transcript on every call. Confirmed against ElevenLabs docs (system__conversation_id, system__conversation_history, dynamic_variable binding in request_body_schema).
name: consult_director
description: Call this at the start of each of your turns, before you speak. It returns a short producer directive (same format as [במאי]/[מצלמה]). Treat the returned directive exactly like a producer message: it governs your very next line. Never read it aloud, never mention calling it.
